csv_scope_of_work: he Town of Freeport, Maine ("Owner") hereby solicits sealed proposals for furnishing all labor, materials, equipment, and services necessary to build the Memorial Park Pavilion / Stage Project. The project consists of the design and construction of a pavilion / stage structure, ADAcompliant access improvements, site work, and associated utilities within Memorial Park. All work shall be performed in accordance with applicable codes, ordinances, and standards of the Town of Freeport. The necessary Building Permits are required, but the fee(s) will be waived.
